observations: Photo 0 shows a black DSLR camera body with 'Canon' logo and 'EOS 1300D' text printed on the body, held in a hand, lens cap on the front element.
Photo 1 shows the same camera from the top/back, with lens zoom markings '18-24-35-55', a mode dial, hot-shoe mount, and a neck strap attached.
No photo shows the camera powered on, the LCD screen, a battery, a charger, a memory card, the rear lens element, or the inside of the box.
No visible physical damage (dents, cracks) on the parts shown, but image resolution and angle limit close inspection of the lens glass and ports.

claims.claim: Clean and new like one from the box, not used for [cut off]
claims.evidence: No photo shows a box, accessories, or a powered-on state to support a 'like new' or low-usage claim; only external body/lens shots are given.
No photo shows the camera powered on, a test shot, the LCD display, or shutter count to confirm functionality.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or have a mechanical/electronic fault (common issue with older DSLRs)
risks.proof: A photo or short clip of the camera powered on, showing the LCD menu or a live preview
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for parts

risks.risk: Shutter count could be very high, shortening remaining lifespan
risks.proof: A photo of the shutter count from a menu screen or EXIF data from a test photo
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/high-use shutter, lowering value

risks.risk: Lens glass could have fungus, haze, or scratches not visible under the cap
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the front and rear lens elements with the cap off, in good light
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens condition unknown, deducted as if moderate wear

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, original box) could reduce completeness despite 'from the box' claim
risks.proof: A photo of all included accessories laid out together with the camera
risks.if_unproven: priced as body + lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: LCD screen could be cracked, scratched, or have dead pixels
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear LCD screen, powered on
risks.if_unproven: priced as screen condition unknown, deducted as if damaged

proof_requests: A clip of the camera powering on and showing a live view or test shot
A photo of the shutter count from the camera's menu or a test image's EXIF data
A close-up of the front and rear lens elements with caps removed
A photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, strap, memory card, box)
A clear photo of the rear LCD screen while powered on
response.reason: Brand and model are clearly readable in both photos, allowing identification, but no evidence confirms power-on function, shutter count, or lens/screen condition, so the camera must be priced at worst case as an unverified-working body-and-lens unit pending further proof.
